note: Views Autosubmit ships one Views exposed_form plugin, id 'autosubmit' (class Autosubmit extends ExposedFormPluginBase). It defines no new plugin type, no settings form, no configure route, no permissions, no Drush. Its state is entirely in the view display config at display_options.exposed_form.type: autosubmit with options.autosubmit_hide (bool, default TRUE) and options.timeout (int ms, default 500). Medium/hard cases are grounded in real view config: introspection reads back which view uses autosubmit and its timeout; execution switches a view's exposed-form style to autosubmit and sets its options, verified against the live views.view config.

evals.prompt: Using the views_autosubmit module, how do I make a View's exposed filter form submit automatically instead of requiring a click on Apply? Where in the Views UI do I select it?
evals.expected_output: In the view editor, under Advanced -> Exposed form -> 'Exposed form style', change from Basic to 'Autosubmit' and Apply/Save. This sets display_options.exposed_form.type to 'autosubmit'. Usually also enable Use AJAX so results refresh in place.

evals.prompt: What options does the views_autosubmit 'Autosubmit' exposed form plugin provide, and what are their default values?
evals.expected_output: Two options: autosubmit_hide (boolean, default TRUE) hides the submit button when JavaScript is enabled, and timeout (integer milliseconds, default 500) is the debounce delay after the user stops typing before the form auto-submits.

evals.prompt: What is the plugin id and plugin type of the exposed-form plugin provided by views_autosubmit, and which core base class does it extend?
evals.expected_output: It is a Views exposed_form plugin with id 'autosubmit' (annotation @ViewsExposedForm), class Drupal\views_autosubmit\Plugin\views\exposed_form\Autosubmit, extending core ExposedFormPluginBase. It does not define a new plugin type.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a view with machine name va_known that uses the Autosubmit exposed form. Inspect the live view configuration and report the timeout (in milliseconds) configured for its autosubmit exposed form.
evals.expected_output: The va_known view's default display has exposed_form.type: autosubmit with options.timeout: 1200 (and autosubmit_hide: false).

evals.prompt: This site has two views, va_auto and va_basic. Exactly one of them uses the views_autosubmit 'Autosubmit' exposed form style. Inspect the live view configurations and state which view autosubmits its exposed filters.
evals.expected_output: va_auto uses the autosubmit exposed form (display_options.exposed_form.type: autosubmit); va_basic uses the default 'basic' exposed form.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a view with machine name va_task whose default display currently uses the 'Basic' exposed form. Using the views_autosubmit module, change the default display's exposed form style to Autosubmit and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.va_task the default display's display_options.exposed_form.type is changed from 'basic' to 'autosubmit' (e.g. edit the view and set Exposed form style to Autosubmit, or set the config and save).

evals.prompt: The va_conf view on this site already uses the Autosubmit exposed form, but its submit button is shown and its typing timeout is 500 ms. Configure the autosubmit exposed form on va_conf's default display so the submit button is hidden (autosubmit_hide on) and the timeout is 2500 ms, and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.va_conf the default display's exposed_form (type autosubmit) has options.autosubmit_hide: true and options.timeout: 2500.
